capacity:applications.title: Applications can't keep up
capacity:applications.message: At the diagram's own rates, it gets 400/s and handles 246/s (163%): its backlog only grows.
capacity:applications.rationale: Demand above what a service can handle never drains: latency and backlog grow until something times out. Live view's Show capacity has the same numbers.

capacity:caller.title: Decision service: scenario sizing
capacity:caller.message: In “Threads held: CPU says all is well”, more than half the busy threads are waiting. Scale on busy threads (modelled custom metric). A rerun with this change confirmed it.
capacity:caller.rationale: Played headless with the same engine and seed as playback; a suggestion is offered as a fix only when a rerun with it bears it out.
capacity:caller.shownMessage: In “Threads held: CPU says all is well”, most of its threads are waiting on calls, rather than working, so CPU stays low. Scale on busy threads instead. A rerun had a smaller backlog.
capacity:caller.shownRationale: Played with the same engine and seed as playback. A suggestion is a fix only when a rerun with it bears it out.
